jub.role: ballet artist (second dancer); inventor of the Stepanov dance-notation system
jub.dates: † 16-го января 1896 г. (Moscow, Mariinskaya hospital); born 17 June 1866
jub.evidence_verbatim: составилъ себѣ имя изобрѣтеніемъ весьма практичной и остроумной системы записыванія, посредствомъ нотныхъ знаковъ, человѣческихъ тѣлодвиженій
jub.evidence_english: SP ballet dancer (corps 1885, coryphée 1887/1889, second dancer 2nd class 1 Oct 1893) who made his name by inventing a system for recording human movement in musical notes, allowing whole ballets to be preserved.
jub.notes: Key entry. Commission of ballet masters and first artists approved the system (protocol of 24 Feb 1891); sent abroad May 1891, chiefly Paris, where Grand Opéra ballet master Гансенъ took part; published 1892 «Alphabet des mouvements du corps humain. Essai d'enregistrement des mouvements du corps humain au moyen des signes musicaux»; returned 14 July 1892; system introduced into the SP Theatre School programme from 1 Sept 1893; sent to Moscow 20 Sept 1895 to introduce it there, fell ill and died. Married to SP ballet artist М. А. Эрлеръ 2-я. Named in the ballet season review.
